name: Repository-owned canonical handoff
purpose: Validate and author one deterministic successor-agent handoff in an existing authorized repository without archives, duplicate clones, or provider-side action claims.
core_owns: existing worktree path/branch/HEAD and preimage gating
atomic write and local verification receipt
adapters_own: authenticated provider commits and remote readback
execution_environments: Python 3.11+ on Windows/Linux/macOS with Git CLI available for write/verify
provider-native consumers can render the exact content without local Git
secret_policy: No credentials, private continuity-store locators, or personal filesystem paths in tracked handoff packets.
prompt_ownership: TokenCorridor is canonical for P01 and every P-number; this capability owns no prompt definitions or authority routing.
reference_consumer: EndeavorEverlasting/ParallaxPort PR #36 (independent repo-owned handoff; exemplar only, not a runtime dependency)
